name: Shiratsume Kurumi
source:
1st year high school student who recently transferred into Houjou Academy.
She transferred in not knowing about the special 'Kuge' course, but she meets [url=/c47431]Satsuki[/url] and [url=/c47432]Iori[/url] by chance and gets wrapped up in the HONEY system.
translation:
1st year high school student who recently transferred into Houjou Academy.
She transferred in not knowing about the special 'Kuge' course, but she meets [url=/c47431]Satsuki[/url] and [url=/c47432]Iori[/url] by chance and gets wrapped up in the HONEY system.
